jsonc-comments.defaults: Shared settings merged into each output.
jsonc-comments.defaults.pcbdoc: Optional PcbDoc selector when a PrjPcb contains more than one board.
jsonc-comments.defaults.layer: PCB layer selector. Options: bottom, top, native layer name, layer id.
jsonc-comments.defaults.z_mm: Bottom Z plane for generated bodies.
jsonc-comments.defaults.thickness_mm: Nominal extrusion thickness before feature bias.
jsonc-comments.defaults.board_outline: Board outline and cutout body styling.
jsonc-comments.defaults.board_outline.color: STEP color for the outer board outline body.
jsonc-comments.defaults.board_outline.cutout_color: STEP color for interior board cutout outline bodies.
jsonc-comments.defaults.board_outline.cutouts: Include separate bodies around interior board cutouts.
jsonc-comments.defaults.board_outline.width_mm: Outline stroke body width in millimeters.
jsonc-comments.defaults.board_outline.fuse: Request Geometer planar fusion for outline bodies.
jsonc-comments.outputs: Output definitions. Each item inherits defaults and overrides selected fields.
jsonc-comments.outputs.name: Output id for filename tokens and logs.
jsonc-comments.outputs.output_step: Output STEP path template. Supports {board}, {Board}, {layer}, {Layer}, {output}, and {Output}.
jsonc-comments.outputs.features: Copper feature selection, color, body-name, and thickness-bias policy.
jsonc-comments.outputs.features.defaults: Fallback feature styling. color is the fallback copper color.
jsonc-comments.outputs.features.component_pads.mode: Component pad mode. Options: none, all, matching_designators.
jsonc-comments.outputs.features.component_pads.include_: Case-insensitive shell patterns for component designators.
jsonc-comments.outputs.features.component_pads.highligh: Rules that split matching component pads into separately colored STEP bodies.
Case-insensitive shell patterns for this highlight rule.
jsonc-comments.outputs.features.free_pads: Pads not owned by a component.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.mode: Global drill mode. Options: auto, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.selected_component_mode: Drill mode for pads selected by component_pads. Options: inherit, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.other_component_mode: Drill mode for unselected component-owned pads. Options: inherit, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.free_pad_mode: Drill mode for pads not owned by a component. Options: inherit, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.via_mode: Drill mode for via holes. Options: inherit, cut, overlay, none.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.minimum_diameter_mm: Omit drill overlays/cuts below this diameter.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.color: Default STEP color for drill overlay bodies.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.plated_color: STEP color for plated drill overlay bodies.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.non_plated_color: STEP color for non-plated drill overlay bodies.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.ring_width_mm: Fixed annulus width when drill shape is ring.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.plated_ring_shape: Plated drill ring policy. Options: annulus.
jsonc-comments.outputs.drills.overlay_thickness_mm: Z thickness for separate drill overlay bodies.
jsonc-comments.outputs.fuse_copper: Request Geometer planar fusion for copper bodies.

jsonc-key-comments.color: STEP color for this body or rule.
jsonc-key-comments.thickness_bias_mm: Symmetric Z bias that prevents overlapping colored bodies from z-fighting.

header-lines: pcb-layer-step creates compact fixture-alignment models, not full fabrication STEP exports.
This file is JSONC, not strict JSON. Comments and trailing commas are accepted.
Feature bodies are extruded by Geometer from 2D regions.
thickness_mm controls nominal layer thickness; thickness_bias_mm is symmetric and prevents z-fighting.
defaults: shared settings copied into every output.
outputs: one or more output definitions; each output overrides only what it needs.
name, output_step, pcbdoc, layer, z_mm, thickness_mm
Patterns are case-insensitive shell-style matches, for example ["TP*"], ["TP*", "J*", "U1"], or ["M*"].
Colors may be #RRGGBB values or these names: black, blue, brown, copper, gray, green, grey, orange, purple, red, white, yellow.
Options: none, cut, overlay, auto. Scoped modes add inherit.
Options: solid, ring. plated_ring_shape options: annulus.
